text:
alex_growth: Morning — noticing a jump in handoff SLA breaches starting ~06:00 PST, about +18% vs baseline. Looks concentrated around timezone buckets.

tasha_ops: same here. Metrics show a spike at 06:15 UTC. Many leads stuck in 'Pending Enrichment' >5m.

jonathan_pm: do we have a quick hypothesis? HubSpot workflow change? downstream enrichment timeouts?

maria_data: pulling the HS webhook logs and enrichment traces now. Early sign: enrichment service returning 504s for some payloads where geo=ap-southeast-1. Sample event: 
```json
{"hs_id":"12345","status":"pending_enrichment","arrival_ts":1719234450,"attempts":1}
```

sasha_sales: impact: 8 SDRs reported unassigned leads in their queues; some VIPs routed to AE incorrectly. :grimacing:

hubspot_bot: Workflow "Inbound -> Enrich -> RR-Assign" triggered 234 events in the last 30m, 17 failures on enrichment step.

eva_engineer: quick mitigation proposal: reduce enrichment TTL to 30s (from 120s) and add a fallback assign to `default-owner` at 90s. Draft HS decision rule: 
```
IF enrichment_status != "complete" AND time_since_arrival > 90s
THEN assign owner = default_sdr_queue
ELSE continue
```

tasha_ops: +1 to fallback. Also recommend a sticky-prospect rule for fairness: if prospect had an owner within last 7 days, prefer reassign back to them (so we don't keep bouncing).

jonathan_pm: agree on sticky rule, but we need a safe-guards doc. Maria — can you replay a 1h window to estimate false reassignments?

maria_data: running the replay now against last 1h of events. ETA ~12m. I will surface counts and a CSV.

ops_bot: Ticket created: INB-621 — "Inbound fallback TTL + sticky-prospect policy". Priority: P1. Assignees: eva_engineer, tasha_ops.

alex_growth: can we add an observability alert for p90 time_to_owner > 2m sustained over 5m so we catch this earlier?

eva_engineer: yes — I'll add the alert and a canary rollout plan: route 10% of traffic to the new fallback policy, monitor for errors, then 50/100.

sasha_sales: pls also add a SalesOps alert: ping channel #salesops when VIP lead unassigned >30s. That one caused the AE tickets.

maria_data: replay results: 1,147 events in window. The fallback would have prevented ~82% of current SLA breaches. Export saved: /infra/ingest/replays/1719234567.csv

alex_growth: great. Approve quick patch rollout to reduce customer friction. Who can push TTL change and start canary?

eva_engineer: I'll push the TTL tweak and create the 10% canary at 10:20 PT, then monitor dashboards. Will post canary link here. Tagging release in #release-war-room.

tasha_ops: updating the inbound playbook with steps and escalation matrix. Will notify SDR rotation and create a short comms blurb. @sasha_sales please draft 1-pager for SDRs explaining temporary behavior.

sasha_sales: on it — ETA 25m, will include examples of what to do if they see unassigned VIPs.

hubspot_bot: Deployment scheduled by eva_engineer at 1719235800.

alex_growth: Thanks everyone. After canary, we should schedule a post-mortem and confirm sticky rule corner-cases before making permanent.
